findings.claim: PRD requires one `table.ts` row per agent with install mode, project source, event-name map and tool-name map. No doc (PRD, TECH-SPEC, ADR-0007) states Qwen Code's project source value, even though ADR-0007:89 says ProjectContext is resolved once from 'the adapter's single projectSource' and Q11 says 'one named project source per host, no fallback chain.'
findings.evidence: grep across docs/v2/*.md and docs/v2/adr/*.md for 'project source' near 'qwen' returns no hits. v1 src/adapters/claude-code-base.ts:64,77,86,113 resolves projectDir as `process.env[this.projectDirEnvVar] ?? process.cwd()`, and Qwen's adapter sets `projectDirEnvVar = "QWEN_PROJECT_DIR"` (src/adapters/qwen-code/index.ts:47). That `??` is a two-step fallback (env var, then cwd), the exact shape Q11 forbids, and it is never named as Qwen's single source in any v2 doc.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 2861d45f 'feat(adapter): add Qwen Code adapter with TDD tests'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: give the MCP/hook code a project root when QWEN_PROJECT_DIR is present (qwen-code docs/users/features/hooks.md:105 confirms the host sets QWEN_PROJECT_DIR in hook command environments). REGRESSION_RISK: outside a hook invocation (for example at bare MCP server start before any hook has run) `process.env.QWEN_PROJECT_DIR` is unset, so the v1 code silently falls back to cwd — the fallback chain Q11 bans, and undocumented in v2. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep QWEN_PROJECT_DIR as the one source when running as a hook command; for the MCP server process (no guarantee that var is exported to it), state explicitly how project source is resolved with no cwd fallback, matching Q11.
findings.fix: Add a Qwen row to `table.ts`/ADR-0007 naming QWEN_PROJECT_DIR as the single project source, state whether the MCP server process (as opposed to hook commands) also receives it, and remove the `?? process.cwd()` fallback from the shared base adapter or gate it so Qwen never falls through silently. Add a GP7 case for Qwen with the var unset: doctor must report 'project source missing', never cwd.

findings.evidence: cm-main `git grep -n getRoutingInstructionsConfig` returns only the definition at src/adapters/qwen-code/index.ts:387 (method body) and bundled copies of the same file; no call site in src/. The base class that would invoke it (writeRoutingInstructions-style caller used for Codex/Kimi/OpenClaw) has no Qwen branch.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 2861d45f 'feat(adapter): add Qwen Code adapter with TDD tests' added the method as part of the HookAdapter interface contract, matching Codex/Kimi/OpenClaw, but no later commit wires it to a write call for Qwen specifically. ORIGINAL_INTENT: interface parity across adapters, not an active feature. REGRESSION_RISK: low; v2 doc overstates confirmed behaviour as [V] when it is unused code. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: verify with a live `qwen` install whether QWEN.md is ever written before deciding to drop the method.
